name: kivi
description: WYSIWYG Markdown editor and knowledge management system

kivi.appearance.editorBackground.markdownDescription: Override the editor background color (e.g. `#1f1f1f`). Leave empty to inherit from the current VS Code theme.

kivi.appearance.codeBlockBackground.markdownDescription: Override the code block background color (e.g. `#181818`). Leave empty to use the default.

kivi.appearance.accentColor.markdownDescription: Override the accent/link color (e.g. `#4daafc`). Leave empty to inherit from the current VS Code theme.

kivi.appearance.textColor.markdownDescription: Override the main editor text color (e.g. `#d4d4d4`). Leave empty to inherit from the current VS Code theme.

kivi.appearance.headingColor.markdownDescription: Override the heading text color (e.g. `#e6e6e6`). Leave empty to derive from the text color.

kivi.appearance.fontSize.markdownDescription: Editor font size in pixels. Set to `0` to inherit from VS Code's `editor.fontSize`.

kivi.appearance.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Editor font family (e.g. `'Inter', sans-serif`). Leave empty to use the system default.

kivi.appearance.lineHeight.markdownDescription: Editor line height as a unitless ratio (e.g. `1.7`). Set to `0` for the default.

kivi.appearance.customCSS.markdownDescription:
Custom CSS to inject into the Kivi editor webview. Useful for advanced theming. Example:
```css
.kivi-vscode-editor h1 { color: #ff8800; }
```

kivi.ui.showToolbar.description: Show the formatting toolbar at the top of the editor.

kivi.ui.showLineNumbers.description: Show line numbers in the editor gutter (experimental).
